title: Big Data Analytics in Manufacturing
welcome_lead: Volume, velocity, variety — and the patterns hidden inside.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: big data analytics in smart manufacturing.
final_note: Data is the new raw material.

concepts.def: Datasets too large or fast for traditional databases.
Volume, Velocity, Variety — the classic big-data dimensions.
Repository storing raw data in native format.
Algorithms learning patterns from data without explicit programming.
Overall Equipment Effectiveness — availability x performance x quality.

walkthroughs.body_html: The 3 Vs framework (Doug Laney, 2001): Volume (size), Velocity (rate of arrival), Variety (formats). Some authors add Veracity and Value to make 5.
OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality. World-class is ~85%; typical factories run 40-60%. Data analytics on machine downtime and reject rate drives OEE improvement.
Machine learning models trained on sensor and image data detect quality drift before scrap occurs — vision systems on the line, vibration signatures from spindles, infrared on welding.
